description: Bug fixes round 2 - Bet slip display issues, submission errors, layout fixes, and bet details improvements

userStories.title: Fix Duplicate Team Display When Both Moneylines Selected
userStories.description: As a player, I want to see the correct team names when I select both moneylines on the same game so that I can clearly identify each selection.
acceptanceCriteria: When both moneylines are selected (e.g., Hawks ML and Rockets ML), each bet slip item shows the correct team name
No duplicate team names displayed in bet slip
Verify the issue is in the display logic (BetSlipSheet) not the selection logic (BetSlipManager)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Fixed ForEach id to use BetSlipItem (which includes side in hash) instead of just marketId

userStories.title: Fix 'Requested function was not found' Error on Bet Submission
userStories.description: As a player, I want to submit bets without getting a 'function not found' error so that my bets are placed successfully.
acceptanceCriteria: Identify which code path is still calling a non-existent Edge Function
Check all bet submission flows: single bets, parlays, BetSlipSheet, BetConfirmationSheet, SubmitBetView
Ensure all submissions call the correct submit_bet Edge Function
Verify the Edge Function is deployed and accessible
Bet submissions complete successfully without NOT_FOUND error
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Fixed by using sideIndicator ('a' or 'b') instead of side (team name) in BetSlipSheet and SubmitBetView. The Edge Function validates side must be 'a' or 'b'.

userStories.title: Fix Overlapping CTAs on Game Table View
userStories.description: As a player, I want the betting buttons on each game row to be properly spaced so that I can tap them accurately.
acceptanceCriteria: Identify where the overlapping CTAs occur (likely GameCardView, CompactGameRow, or market table)
Fix spacing/layout so buttons do not overlap
Ensure buttons are tappable without accidentally hitting adjacent buttons
Test on various screen sizes
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Fixed by changing teamOddsRow frame height from 36pt to oddsButtonHeight (44pt) in CompactGameRow.swift

userStories.title: Fix Background Colors on Player Settings CTAs
userStories.description: As a player, I want the settings buttons to have consistent styling so that the UI looks cohesive.
acceptanceCriteria: Update 'Account' button/section background to use Theme.cardBackground
Update 'Test Mode' button/section background to use Theme.cardBackground
Ensure consistent styling with rest of the app
Check PlayerMainView or PlayerSettingsView for the affected components
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Display 'To Win' Amount Alongside Stake on Bet Views
userStories.description: As a bookie or player, I want to see the potential payout ('To Win') amount alongside the stake so that I can quickly understand the bet's value.
acceptanceCriteria: Player bet views show 'To Win: $X' alongside the stake
Bookie bet summary views show 'To Win: $X' alongside the stake
Calculate 'To Win' based on odds and stake (American odds conversion)
Update relevant views: BetsListView, TrackView, TicketDetailView, BetDetailView
Use consistent formatting (e.g., 'Stake: $50 | To Win: $45.45')
Typecheck passes
